# MATCH & MEET

> MATCH & MEET is a compatibility-led matchmaking service in Bangkok, Thailand, for adults aged 30–60 who want a committed relationship. Each guest completes a private compatibility assessment and is reviewed by a matchmaker, then meets a small number of people chosen for fit at a hosted event. Separate events are held for gay men (Men & Men), lesbians (Women & Women) and straight singles (Men & Women). Slogan: "Connecting people meaningfully again."

Key facts (last updated 9 October 2026):

- Location: Bangkok, Thailand. Events are held in person.
- Audience: single adults aged 30–60 in Bangkok. Applicants must be 20 or over.
- First event: Men & Men, late November 2026. Applications are open to all segments now.
- Price: event entry is 2,590 baht (about US$75), paid only after the application is approved. It includes the personal Compatibility Passport.
- Applying is free, takes about 4 minutes, and is reviewed within 2 working days.
- After approval and payment, guests complete a private compatibility assessment (about 25 minutes).
- Optional membership: US$20 a month for compatible new profiles each month and discounted event entry.
- Privacy: only the matchmaking team sees applications, photos and assessment answers. Nothing is shared with third parties or other applicants without permission.
- Contact: soulmates@matchandmeet.life
- Apply: https://apply.matchandmeet.life
